events.title: Demo Patch Notes – Ver. 0.0.1.4
events.summary: Hello miners,Thank you for playing Chroma Miners!Early-game progression has been slightly accelerated, and mid-game pacing has been adjusted for a smoother experience.Thanks for playing the demo.Feedback is always welcome!

events.title: Demo Hotfix – Ver. 0.0.1.3
events.summary: Hello miners,Thank you for playing Chroma Miners!A hotfix has been released to address an issue that prevented players from progressing in the game.If your game version is below Ver. 0.0.1.3 and the update hasn't downloaded, please restart Steam to download the latest patch.Sorry for the inconvenience.Thanks for playing the demo. Feedback is always welcome!

events.title: Chroma Miners Demo is OUT NOW!
events.summary: Hello,I'm thrilled to announce that the Chroma Miners Demo is now available!Guide your Chrobits as they mine, refine, and collect tons of colors! Automate their work, discover new synergies, and watch your mining operation grow in this relaxing incremental game.I hope you enjoy the demo! If you'd like to support the game's development, wishlisting Chroma Miners on Steam is one of the best ways to help!I'd like to hear your thoughts, so feel free to share your feedback.Happy mining :)
